title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Job Title: Customer Service
Type: Temporary - 3 months
Location: Eastleigh
Salary: £15.27 - £19.84 per hour

BRC are working closely with a customer-focused organisation who are looking for an Operational Support Assistant to join their team in Eastleigh on a 3-month temporary basis.

This role involves providing high-quality administrative and customer service support across the organisation, helping frontline teams deliver efficient services while maintaining accurate records and a professional, responsive approach.

Duties:
- Monitor team work queues and mailboxes, ensuring requests are actioned within agreed timescales.
- Raise orders for Energy Performance Certificates (EPCs) and request, save and maintain certificates.
- Liaise with internal teams via telephone, email and in person.
- Produce decoration vouchers and payment cards for customers.
- Update records relating to Housing Benefit changes and produce letters using templates.
- Process incoming and outgoing post, ensuring documents are scanned and distributed correctly.
- Raise repair requests on behalf of colleagues working in the field.
- Maintain customer records for Authority to Discuss (ATD) applications and renewals.
- Act as a first point of contact for visitors and colleagues, providing a welcoming and professional service.
- Review out-of-hours logs and take appropriate action.
- Process and review HomeSwapper applications, working closely with the Housing team.
- Process and index customer key fob requests.

Requirements:
- Previous experience in a customer service or administrative role.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.
- Excellent attention to detail and accurate data entry skills.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Ability to work independently, use initiative and remain calm under pressure.
- Confidence using office equipment and handling confidential information.
- A professional, friendly and customer-focused approach.

For more information, please call Meg Smith on (phone number removed) or (phone number removed).

To apply, please submit your CV outlining your relevant experience and qualifications.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Due to the high volume of applications we may receive, we may not be able to respond to every applicant. If you have not heard from us within 72 hours, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

Referral Scheme: Know someone who would be suitable for this role? Recommend a friend or colleague and you could receive up to £100 once they have completed three months working through BRC. T&Cs apply.

title: Student Services Administrator
description:
Student Services Administrator (Temporary) Location: Eastleigh

Pay Rate: 13.50 - 14.00 per hour Hours: Full Time on site
Duration: Temporary, Immediate Start until Christmas

Are you an experienced administrator looking for a full-time temporary role with an immediate start?

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Student Services Administrator to support a busy education provider in Eastleigh. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with strong administration skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and providing excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing student applications using the internal application system and database.
- Booking student interviews and maintaining accurate records using spreadsheets.
- Liaising with prospective students via email and responding to enquiries.
- Providing administrative support to the Student Services team.
- Ensuring all information is processed accurately and efficiently.

What we're looking for:
- Previous administration experience is essential.
- Strong IT skills, including experience using databases and Microsoft Office.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Strong written communication skills.
- A proactive and professional approach to work.

Important Information:
- An Enhanced DBS is required for this position. Candidates with a current transferable DBS are highly desirable; however, we can arrange a new DBS check for successful applicants.
- This is a temporary position with an immediate start available.

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.
